overview: 39 official Group 1 Qs (2017, 2019, 2023, 2024) on the AP economy after 2014 and the AP Reorganisation Act. 2017–19 were one-liners on Act provisions, numbers and AP app/scheme names; 2023–24 are mostly 3–5-statement items on current AP schemes, ports, policies and awards. APRA provisions (8 Qs) and AP agriculture/industry initiatives (9 Qs) lead; several 2023–24 keys could not be verified beyond the official key.

possibility.angle: AP economy after bifurcation – basic features and fiscal data
possibility.what_they_ask: admin counts (revenue divisions in 2014), GSDP trend, revenue vs fiscal deficit, land resurvey technology

possibility.angle: Impact of bifurcation on resources and state revenue
possibility.what_they_ask: debt–GSDP ratio of 2014-15; natural targets: loss of Hyderabad revenue, resource gap, 14th FC revenue deficit grant
composition of the Apex Council; natural targets: GRMB/KRMB seats, KWDT-II extension

possibility.angle: New challenges to industry and commerce
possibility.what_they_ask: cause of decline of a traditional AP industry (Markapur slate – changed user preference)
port status (major vs minor) and PPP model, Bhogapuram airport funding, Setu Bandhan ROBs, Green Hydrogen policy targets and nodal agency
name of an award-winning app (D-Krishi), ULB computerisation project (e-Suvidha), purpose of a police app

possibility.angle: AP initiatives in agriculture and allied sectors
possibility.what_they_ask: amount and instalments of Rythu Bharosa, CCRC expansion, APFAMGS principle, donor of an externally aided project, fisheries welfare details

possibility.angle: AP initiatives in industry and investment
possibility.what_they_ask: investment promotion body (APEDB), sector-policy job targets, WEF MoUs, Industrial Policy 2023-27 numbers

possibility.angle: AP social sector – health and education
possibility.what_they_ask: helpline numbers (102 Talli Bidda), Aarogyasri limit, Family Doctor link with PHCs, which towns got new medical colleges in 2023

possibility.angle: Urbanisation and smart cities in AP
possibility.what_they_ask: number of municipal corporations (dated), AMRUT ranking order, Swachh Survekshan award by city and category

possibility.angle: Skill development and employment in AP
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets by analogy with the scheme items: APSSDC role, skill universities/hubs, job targets of sector policies, local-employment rules for industries
which community got a special budget cover, WD&CW scheme coverage (Sampoorna Poshana vs Plus), partner organisations

possibility.angle: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 – structure and provisions
possibility.what_they_ask: number of schedules, content of a Part, debt sharing basis, asset-sharing rule, Polavaram status/funding/executor, mentor institute for new institutions

possibility.angle: Central assistance for the new capital
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets: the Act's provision for central support to the new capital, amounts released for Amaravati, expert committee on capital location

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs (the 2016-17 special assistance figure includes these components)
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets: 7 backward districts (4 Rayalaseema + 3 North Coastal), ₹50 crore per district per year, resource-gap grant for 2014-15

possibility.angle: 13th Schedule projects – railway zone, Kadapa steel, Dugarajapatnam, corridors
possibility.what_they_ask: divisions of the South Coast Railway zone, VCIC funding/length/nodes

possibility.angle: Special Category Status vs Special Assistance
possibility.what_they_ask: amount of special assistance in 2016-17; natural targets: SCS was a PM assurance not in the Act, 14th FC stance, 90:10 funding pattern

traps.trap: Merges funder and executor of Polavaram
traps.spot: Options that assign construction, funding and status to one government
traps.fix: Polavaram = National Project (s.90); Centre funds the irrigation component at 1-4-2014 cost; State executes (NITI Aayog advice)
traps.pyq: 'NITI Aayog [...] construction responsibility' → State Government [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#87]; funding → irrigation component from 01/04/2014 [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#15]; status → National Project [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#82]

traps.trap: Gives the State a power only the Centre has
traps.fix: Major ports are declared by the Union; GoAP/APMB handle minor (non-major) ports
traps.pyq: Krishnapatnam 'Major Port' false → II, III, IV [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#94]

traps.trap: Letter-swaps a scheme or app name
traps.spot: Four options differing by one letter or prefix (C/D/E/B-Krishi; e-Seva/e-Suvidha)
traps.fix: Memorise the exact brand: D-Krishi (CSI-Nihilent 2017-18), e-Suvidha (ULBs), e-Pragati (state architecture), MeeSeva/eSeva (citizen services)

traps.trap: Inverts the target area of a 'Plus' scheme
traps.fix: YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus covers the 77 tribal mandals; the plain scheme covers the rest
traps.pyq: Statement III false → I and IV [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#96]

traps.trap: Moves an institution to the twin district
traps.spot: East vs West Godavari, Krishna vs Guntur pairs
traps.fix: AP Fisheries University – Narsapur, West Godavari

traps.trap: Swaps a division between railway zones
traps.spot: Zone composition options with Waltair or Rayagada
traps.fix: South Coast Railway: Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada (+ new Visakhapatnam division); Rayagada goes to ECoR

traps.trap: Alters a scheme amount or its split
traps.spot: Options mixing totals and Centre/State shares
traps.fix: Rythu Bharosa–PM Kisan: ₹13,500 a year = ₹7,500 AP + ₹6,000 Centre, three instalments (2019-24)

traps.trap: Swaps the composition of a statutory council
traps.spot: Apex Council options changing chair or members' rank
traps.fix: Apex Council: Union Water Resources (Jal Shakti) Minister chairs; the two Chief Ministers are members

techniques.name: Act-structure recall
techniques.how: Hold the APRA skeleton: 12 Parts, 108 sections, 13 Schedules; Part V = expenditure and revenue, Part VI = assets and liabilities, Part IX = water, 13th Schedule = institutions and infrastructure. Use it to reject a near number or a neighbour Part.
techniques.example: 'How many Schedules' [...]: 14/15/16 fall, 13 stays [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#83]; Part V → expenditure and distribution of revenues [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#81]

techniques.name: Location vs ratio rule for sharing
techniques.how: Fixed assets follow location; general debt and cash follow a ratio (population 58.32:41.68 under the Act, or an agreed ratio). Discard options applying one rule to everything.
techniques.example: APSCHE: assets by location, only cash/balances by ratio → option 2 [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#85]

techniques.name: Deficit arithmetic
techniques.how: Fiscal deficit = revenue deficit + capital outlay + net lending, so a budgeted RD above FD (in % GSDP) is impossible unless capital outlay is negative.
techniques.example: 'RD budgeted higher than FD' falls; banana award and resurvey hold → I and IV [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#90]

techniques.name: Sum-of-components check
techniques.how: For a package figure, add its known components; the matching option is the total, a near option is usually one component alone.
techniques.example: ₹1,176.50 cr is just the resource-gap part; with ₹350 cr (backward districts) and ₹450 cr (capital) the total is ₹1,976.50 cr [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#107]

techniques.name: Helpline-number ladder
techniques.how: Fix the AP service numbers once: 108 emergency, 104 health information / mobile medical unit, 102 mother-child transport.
techniques.example: Talli Bidda Express is mother–newborn transport → 102 [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#63]

techniques.name: Date-stamp AP counts
techniques.how: Counts of districts, corporations, colleges change; recall the figure for the year the paper was set before choosing.
techniques.example: 2019: AP had 16 municipal corporations (later 17) → 16 [group1-prelims-2019-paper2#117]; 2014: 50 revenue divisions [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#86]

confusions.remember: SCS = PM's Rajya Sabha assurance, not in the Act; Special Assistance = package equal to SCS benefits via EAP funding
National Project, Centre pays irrigation component, State builds
Apex = Union minister + 2 CMs (policy); Boards = technical regulation of projects
Union list vs AP Maritime Board
Investment promotion vs industrial land and parks
Statewide enterprise architecture vs ULB computerisation vs citizen counters
Both for tenant farmers; CCRC gives benefits only, no land rights
SCoR (Visakhapatnam HQ) has Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada; Rayagada stays in ECoR
Integrated irrigation-agriculture transformation vs irrigation and livelihood improvement
Schedule-13 institutions each had a mentor institute
FD includes RD plus capital outlay, so FD ≥ RD

confusions.remember: State-level scheme ranking vs city liveability index

anchors: APRA 2014: 12 Parts, 108 sections, 13 Schedules; appointed day 2 June 2014
Population ratio 58.32 (AP) : 41.68 (Telangana) for general debt sharing
Polavaram – National Project (s.90); Centre funds irrigation component at 1-4-2014 cost
Apex Council – Union Water Resources Minister + CMs of AP and Telangana
7 backward districts: 4 Rayalaseema + 3 North Coastal, ₹50 crore per district per year
South Coast Railway zone (2019): Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada divisions, HQ Visakhapatnam
13th Schedule: Kadapa steel (SAIL to study), Dugarajapatnam major port, Vizag–Chennai corridor, railway zone
VCIC – ADB-supported, ~800 km of AP coast; Donakonda a node
Rythu Bharosa–PM Kisan: ₹13,500/yr in three instalments
AP Green Hydrogen policy 2023: NREDCAP nodal agency
checklist: Is the claim from the Act itself, a later order, or a political assurance?
Who funds, who executes, who declares – Centre, State or a board?
Read the exact scheme/app name letter by letter
For counts and amounts, fix the year and add components if a package total is asked
Check twin-district and twin-region swaps (East/West Godavari, Rayalaseema/North Coastal)
For 'Plus'/'except' clauses, confirm which area or group the scheme targets
Where a fact cannot be recalled, decide on the statements you are sure of and use the code options to eliminate
